headings: WHITE POWDERY SCENTED CERAMIC PACK (PACK OF 6)

jsonld_raw.name: WHITE POWDERY SCENTED CERAMIC PACK (PACK OF 6)
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented ceramic wardrobe plates. They can be hung on the wardrobe rail, on hangers, or between clothes, even inside drawers.

Pack of 6.

White Powdery | A tribute to the best personal care traditions. A fusion of the opulence of rose and the delicacy of lily creates a timeless floral essence, with hints of amber and pomegranate. A powdery base of ylang-ylang and cedar envelops this iconic fragrance.

Notes:
Top notes: bergamot, orange, pomegranate.
Heart notes: rose, orris root, ylang-ylang, powdery.
Base notes: oak moss, amber, cedar.


Lasts approximately 4 weeks, depending on usage conditions.
